# `treasury_statement_classification_cells`

**Treasury budget results and financing by classification**

Monthly Treasury Statement Table 2 cells, one per native line and measure, with literal amounts, per-field units and explicit No Transactions, zero and null markers.

**Coverage.** Sampled: explicitly selected MTS issues (2015-03-31, 2025-09-30, 2025-10-31, 2026-03-31 and 2026-09-30 qualified locally). Every issue must carry the 15-line native layout; each 0.00 estimate needs a page-5 review entry in treasury_units.json, and the on/off, receipts-outlays, financing and means-of-financing identities plus the Table 1 month, FYTD and prior-FYTD values refuse on mismatch. Identities skip cells without a number, so editions whose estimates print No Transactions verify fewer estimate identities. One publisher inconsistency ships under a digest-pinned exception: in 2025-09-30 the prior-FYTD means of financing (lines 13-15) exceed financing (line 11), as printed on page 5; the values are unchanged and the gap is pinned in treasury_units.json. Estimates are stated in $ millions; amount_usd scales them to dollars without adding precision. *(measured 2026-10-31)*

- **Parquet file:** `treasury_statement_classification_cells.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report_date` | `DATE` | Source record_date identifying the report issue; joins treasury_statement_periods.report_date. |
| `src_line_nbr` | `INTEGER` | Native Table 2 source line number; with measure and source_release_digest, the row key within an issue. |
| `parent_src_line_nbr` | `INTEGER` | Source line of the native parent classification within the same issue; null for section headings. |
| `print_order_nbr` | `INTEGER` | Native print order on the statement page. |
| `sequence_level_nbr` | `INTEGER` | Native hierarchy depth. |
| `sequence_number_cd_literal` | `VARCHAR` | Exact native sequence code text. |
| `classification_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher classification id. Reassigned for every issue; never join issues on it. |
| `parent_id_literal` | `VARCHAR` | Literal parent classification id, including the text null for headings. |
| `classification_desc` | `VARCHAR` | Original classification label. |
| `data_type_cd` | `VARCHAR` | Native data type code (S heading, T total, D detail). |
| `record_type_cd` | `VARCHAR` | Native record type code. |
| `measure` | `VARCHAR` | Native amount field name, one of current_month_budget_amt, current_fytd_budget_amt, prior_fytd_budget_amt, current_year_budget_est_amt or next_year_budget_est_amt. |
| `measure_fiscal_year` | `INTEGER` | Fiscal year the measure describes; prior fiscal year to date is the report year minus one and next-year estimates plus one. |
| `amount_literal` | `VARCHAR` | Exact original API text, including 0.00 behind a No Transactions marker and the text null. |
| `amount` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Exact amount in amount_unit; null for no_transactions, publisher_null, json_null and blank markers. Never rescaled. |
| `amount_unit` | `VARCHAR` | usd for actuals; usd_millions for budget estimates, whatever the API dataFormats declares. |
| `amount_usd` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | amount in US dollars (usd_millions times 1,000,000); null where amount is null. Estimates are stated to $0.01 million, so their dollar figures are precise only to $10,000; the trailing digits are scale, not publisher precision. |
| `marker_kind` | `VARCHAR` | value, zero (a printed zero), no_transactions (0.00 printed as dots), publisher_null, json_null or blank. |
| `qualification_report_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the explicitly supplied report PDF used to review this issue. |
| `qualification_report_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-stated URL of that report. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native row identity within the admitted source release. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted source release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact release digest; preserves same-issue refreshes and later-issue revisions separately. |
| `source_page_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the original API page containing this row; keys the page review in treasury_units.json. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact request URL, observation time, response digest, byte size and JSON row pointer. |
| `source_selection_json` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit dataset, report date and page size of the source selection. |
| `field_metadata_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original publisher labels, types and display formats; the declared $10.20 CURRENCY format does not give the estimate scale. |
| `raw_row_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete native row with every measure and native code. |
